mapper.select: SELECT e.* FROM routine_exceptions e JOIN routines r ON r.routine_id = e.routine_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND e.type = 'MOVED' AND e.moved_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM routine_exceptions WHERE routine_exception_id = #{routineExceptionId} AND routine_id = #{routineId}
